services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Please request a program at least 3 weeks in advance by emailing us. Depending on availability, groups can combine multiple programs in one field trip - for example, a beach walk and a shore crab survey. Please indicate this in your inquiry email. If booking more than one program, a 10% discount will be given on the total fee. For field trip programs there is a maximum of 35 total people, including children and adults. However, infants under 12 months and 1:1 aides do not count towards this total. We recommend having 1-2 adult chaperones/teachers for every 10 children.
